title: SMAart Studio Membership – Firing Access
source_quote: Every membership includes access to Firing & glazing Cone 10 reduction (Sutter) Cone 5 oxidation (both studios) Raku firing (Sutter)
evidence_sentence: Four membership tiers (ReM, WAM, EAM, RAM) include access to raku, Cone 5 oxidation, and Cone 10 reduction firings with firing fees included or discounted by tier.
evidence_quote: Firing & glazing Cone 10 reduction (Sutter) Cone 5 oxidation (both studios) Raku firing (Sutter)
summary: Memberships at SMAart provide studio access and firing in raku, Cone 5 oxidation, and Cone 10 reduction kilns; rates from $125–$330/month depending on studio access level.
pay_text: Monthly membership from $125–$330; firing costs vary by tier (some include 25 lbs free, bisque under 12" free, or billed by pound).
how_to_join: Book a membership appointment via the website.
